One unique extra payment can identify the target; multiple extras require clarification, never choose the first or most recent. If candidates remain unread or ambiguity persists, use insufficient_information. Do not replace an explicitly named payment with a different one. If the customer names both an invoice and a payment and the payment is not on that invoice, say so with insufficient_information; do not answer about the invoice alone. It is neither a reason to skip work nor a reason to hand the case to someone else.
